title: CreditChargeInfo

Number.description: Product: ALL Description: Credit Card account number, as printed on the card. Must not have whitespace or formatting characters.

Type.description: Product: ALL Description: Type of credit card.[br /]

NameOnAcct.description: Product: ALL Description: Account holder name, as printed on the card.

CcExpiryMonth.description: Product: ALL Description: Expiration Month on card, expressed as a number: 1 = January, 2 = February, etc.

CcExpiryYear.description: Product: ALL Description: Expiration Year on card, expressed as a 4 digit number 1999, 2003, etc.

BillAddrStreet.description: Product: ALL Description: Credit card holder billing address of record: the street address to which credit card statements are sent.

PostalCode.description: Product: ALL Description: Credit card holder billing postal code. Five digits in the USA.

CommercialCardCode.description: Product: ALL Description: Code associated with commercial cards: purchase, corporate, and business cards. Lower transaction fee rates apply when these cards are used and this field is provided.

CCTxnMode.description: Product: ALL Description: Credit card transaction mode used in Credit Card payment transactions. Valid values: CardNotPresent (default) or CardPresent.[br /]

CCTxnType.description: Product: ALL Description: Type of credit card transaction. Valid values: Authorization, Capture, Charge, Refund, VoiceAuthorization.[br /]

PrevCCTransId.description: Product: ALL Description: Unique identifier of the previous payment transaction. It can be used as an input to the Capture transaction type.

Amount.description: Product: QBO Description: The Amount processed using the credit card.

ProcessPayment.description: Product: QBO Description: If false or no value, QBO will not process the payment but just store Credit Card Information. If true, QBO will process the Credit Card Payment (Not supported currently).

CreditCardChargeInfoEx.description: Product: ALL Description: Internal use only: extension place holder for CreditCardChargeInfo

description: Product: ALL Description: Holds credit-card information to request a credit card payment from a merchant account service, but NOT any response or authorization information from the merchant account service provider -- see CreditChargeResponse
